scripts.db:prepare:railway: npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.db:migrate:test: NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/test-database-guard.ts && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed:test: NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/test-database-guard.ts && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset:test: NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/test-database-guard.ts && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test:integration: NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/test-database-guard.ts && vitest run tests/*.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/test-database-guard.ts && vitest run tests/runtime.smoke.integration.test.ts
